description.en: Represents the standard monthly fee for the childcare 'dining service' (comedor) modelled by Spain's childcare-cost policy xcc_es. In xcc_es/BenCalc's 'Costs - Dining Fee' component (Comp_perElig, condition commented 'standard dining fee from 0 to 2'), it is added once for every household member aged 0-2 recorded as being in formal (paid) childcare (input flag dccfc=1), building the gross output variable xcc_s, i.e. the pre-discount childcare/dining cost. Fixed at EUR 96/month since the policy was introduced into the model in 2024, it is the base amount the means-tested 'Becas Comedor' discounts ($xccdc_amt1-3) are set against in the companion 'Deductions' component of the same policy.
